_about: Check-in DMs for quiet members (GreMi 2026-10-14), run by bot/checkin.py and read live. 'on': false stops sending; the buttons keep working. {name} is the member's server name. 'welcome' is sent after ✅. 'last_chance' is shown after the first ❌; only a second ❌ removes them. No answer in remind_days: 'reminder'; still nothing remind_days later: 'goodbye' and removed.
text: Hey {name}! I'm **Race Control**, GreMi's bot. GreMi streams EA F1 and Le Mans Ultimate and races with his viewers in open lobbies. We haven't seen you in a while, so: still up for being part of the gang? 👀
welcome: **Awesome, welcome back! 🏁** A lot changed since you were last here:
🎭 Pick your roles in **Channels & Roles** (top of the channel list). They unlock F1, LMU, leagues and more, and chats like F1-CHAT stay hidden without them.
🎁 Weekly €10 gift card giveaway: hit Enter in GIVEAWAYS, open to everyone.
🤖 Tag @Race Control in the server with any question.
🛒 Code **GREMI10** gets you 10% off at Simgasm.
last_chance: **Before you go, you might have missed a lot:**
📊 Race stats and leaderboards from every stream
🎭 New roles that unlock F1, LMU and league chats
Still want to leave? Then this removes you from the server (you can always come back).
reminder: Hey {name}, quick reminder 👋 Still up for being part of GreMi's gang? Just tap a button. 🏁
goodbye: We didn't hear back from you, so I've taken you off GreMi's server for now. 👋
No hard feelings, you're always welcome back: {invite}
